title: canResolveInflightOperation is a pure core function with complex boolean logic but has no property-based test
description: canResolveInflightOperation (behavioral-spec.md line 35, verification-architecture.md line 39) is classified in the pure core with 4 nullable string parameters and a multi-condition boolean return ('Status known AND IDs consistent AND customer exists'). This function guards inflight operation resolution — a safety-critical decision point. Despite being listed as pure and deterministic, it has no PROP-SYNC entry among PROP-SYNC-001 through PROP-SYNC-015. The function's verifiable property description ('IDs consistent') is also underspecified — it does not define whether 'consistent' means payjpSubId === memberSubId, or both non-null, or something else. Without a property test, boundary conditions (e.g., payjpSubId non-null but memberSubId null, or vice versa) have no formal verification.
recommendation: Add PROP-SYNC-016 for canResolveInflightOperation with explicit enumeration of all boolean branches. Define 'IDs consistent' precisely in the verifiable property column.
